title: tickets.stats — Dashboard Statistics
description: Implement the tickets.stats MCP tool that returns aggregate system statistics for dispatcher decision-making and dashboard display. Queries the tickets and events tables to compute per-stage ticket counts, per-status ticket counts, claim health breakdown (healthy/expiring_soon/expired), average time-in-stage per stage, rework count distribution, total tickets, and total done tickets. May cache results for up to 5 seconds to reduce load.
acceptance_criteria: Tool registered as 'tickets.stats' with Zod schema: time_range_hours (optional number)
Returns stages object mapping each TicketStage to ticket count
Returns statuses object mapping each TicketStatus to ticket count
Returns claims object with healthy (>5min remaining), expiring_soon (<5min remaining), and expired counts
Returns avg_stage_duration mapping each stage to average seconds spent
Returns rework_distribution mapping rework_count values to number of tickets
Response time under 200ms for up to 500 tickets
